transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

I’m here because my sleep has been really broken for a long time. I fall into bed exhausted, but I wake up at every little sound in the house, and then I’m up before my alarm anyway. I just don’t feel like I’ve rested.
Aside from feeling tired, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or hopeless?

Yeah. Most days, it feels like the color has gone out of things. Even at Sunday dinner with my family, or looking at art I used to enjoy, I just don’t feel much. And sometimes I have to really fight back tears, though I couldn’t tell you exactly why.
Roughly how long have you been feeling this down and disconnected from things?
It’s been a little over two years now—since my mother-in-law moved in with us.
During these past two years, have you had any periods where you felt back to your normal self for more than two months at a time?
No, I haven’t really felt back to myself for that long. It’s been this way since my mother-in-law moved in, a little over two years ago.
Before this started two years ago, had you ever experienced any other periods in your life where you felt significantly depressed?
I’m not sure. I can’t really think of another time that felt like this.
During this time, have you been struggling with feelings of worthlessness or excessive guilt?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed feeling especially guilty or worthless, exactly.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn't worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
I’m not sure what you mean exactly. I haven’t really noticed thoughts like that.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight over this time?

Yeah. I just don’t have much of an appetite anymore. I mostly pick at what I make for everyone else, or grab some toast after my shift. My clothes have been fitting looser, and I wasn’t trying to lose weight.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating, staying focused, or making everyday decisions?
I’m not sure I’ve noticed a real problem with that. I mean, I can get through my usual decisions and things.
Have you or others noticed that you are moving or speaking much slower than usual, or conversely, feeling unusually restless and unable to sit still?
I haven’t noticed myself moving or talking slower, no. And I don’t feel especially restless either.
Have you been feeling hopeless about the future or that things won't get better?

I guess so, yes. Most days it feels like the color has gone out of everything. Even at Sunday dinner with my family, or looking at art I used to enjoy, I just feel... flat, and I have to work not to tear up for no clear reason.
Aside from your broken sleep, have you been experiencing low energy or feeling constantly fatigued during the day?
Yes. By the time I’m done seeing my home-health clients and get back home to help there, my body just feels heavy. Even doing my charting or folding laundry can feel like too much to push through.
How has your self-esteem or confidence in yourself been during this time?
I’m not really sure how to judge that. I just know I’ve been having a hard time feeling good about myself lately.
Have you ever had periods of feeling unusually high, energized, or wired, where you needed much less sleep than usual?
I don’t think so. I can’t remember having times where I felt unusually wired or like I barely needed sleep.
